notes.title: Sauces, stains, and keeping your kitchen clean
notes.notes:
[p]Hello!  
I’m still cooking up improvements in [b]Burgie’s Cozy Kitchen[/b], and today I bring a couple of new features that I’m sure you’ll enjoy, especially if you’re one of those who love a bit of chaos. I keep thinking about mechanics that could have good synergy with the rest, and one I just couldn’t leave out are stains — especially with all the sauces around and how common it is to spill things all over the floor.[/p][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s new:[/p][p][b]Floor stains:[/b]  
Now sauces and tomatoes will leave a stain on the floor when they fall. Watch out where they end up! To clean them you’ll need to buy kitchen paper, which adds a little extra challenge to your daily management.[/p][p][b]Smoother experience:[/b]  
I’ve tweaked several functions to make everything feel more fluid and natural, from the controls to interactions with customers. There are new complaints for different actions, and customers will now react with better judgment. Once you play, you’ll definitely notice the difference.[/p][p]I’m very happy with how everything is evolving. Thanks for continuing to play and support the development. Although the bulk of the game is already done, whenever I feel like picking the project back up you’ll keep getting new updates to keep things fresh.[/p][p][/p][p]I’m still at it, little by little! 💪[/p][p]Nau[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45293601/ef967c561c99dacad56c32011535a93e58b10003.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New customers are arriving
notes.notes: [p]Hey! As summer gets closer, I’ve been working on wrapping up a few things in [i]Burgie’s Cozy Kitchen[/i] before taking a bit of a breather. The game is almost done (we’re getting there!), but I wanted to leave a few fun updates ready for you to enjoy in the meantime.[/p][p]Here’s what’s new:[/p][list][*][p][b]New sauces![/b] I’ve added a handful of new sauces to keep things fresh and tasty. Each one has its own vibe and mechanics, and I hope they give you more room to experiment with orders.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Special customers with unique outfits:[/b] Outfit system is joining the mix! Customers will show up with different clothes, modifying their tastes and behavior. It adds a bit more personality and challenge to each shift.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Secret customers to discover:[/b] There are now a few hidden customers in the game. If you find them, their names will appear and you’ll even be able to use them as a skin. It’s a little extra fun, especially if want to show up on any stream with an unique skin.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New achievements:[/b] I’ve also added some achievements that tie together all the new outfits and special customers (plus a few other surprises). If you enjoy completing challenges, there’s more to aim for now.[/p][/*][/list][p]I’m really excited about how everything is coming together. Thanks so much for playing and following the progress. Your support genuinely keeps me going. I can’t wait to show you the final version soon![/p][p]Nau[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45293601/3df6692531d4100a24a76a0af454942cf11bc541.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Play Burgie's in your language!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone, I’m Nau, the developer of [i]Burgie’s Cozy Kitchen[/i] 🍔[/p][p]It really warms my heart to see the game reach players from so many different countries. That’s why this past week I’ve been focused on preparing localization for the languages I’ve seen most in the community.[/p][p]I just released an update that adds full support for 8 new languages:[/p][list][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]Polish[/p][/*][*][p]Turkish[/p][/*][*][p]Russian[/p][/*][*][p]Ukrainian[/p][/*][*][p]Japanese[/p][/*][*][p]Chinese (Simplified)[/p][/*][*][p]Korean[/p][/*][/list][p]So far the game was only available in English, Spanish, French, Italian, and Portuguese — so now there are a total of 13 languages available![/p][p]I did my best to translate everything well, but some languages are completely beyond what I can handle. If you play in one of these new languages, [b]would you be up for telling me how it feels?[/b] I hope everything works smoothly 😅[/p][p]I’d also love to know if your language is among these new ones and if adding it was useful. It makes me feel closer to the people I’m making this for 😊[/p][p]And if you see any text errors or anything odd, please let me know here on the forum. It’s the only way I can find out, and you’d really help me fix things quickly so more players can enjoy it well.[/p][p]See you in the kitchen![/p][p]Thanks for playing 💖[/p]

notes.title: Streamers' update! (Connect to your Twitch, YouTube, Kick or Tiktok LIVE)
notes.notes:
Even though Burgie's Cozy Kitchen started as a chill single-player cooking game, it’s always had a fun twist, a Twitch mode where your viewers can jump in and order virtual burgies while you stream.

Well, we’ve got some tasty news:
We're now the first game to bring this feature to even more live chat platforms!

You can now connect with:
- Twitch.tv chat
- YouTube Live chat
- Kick.com chat
- TikTok LIVE chat

That means more viewers, more interactions, and way more engage with your audience. Perfect to make your channel grow!

Plus, there’s now a Bit queue system: viewers who donate get priority when placing their orders. Just a couple of burgers and you’ve basically paid off the game! 😁

If you stream it, drop your stream links here. I’d love to see your burger joint empire in action!
